lessons.title: A Switch Turns the Light On

audio.key: text:Both patches get the same water.
text:Watch what happens over several days.
text:After several days, the covered grass is pale and weak.
text:A cloud has tiny water drops.
text:It cools and forms tiny drops in clouds.
text:The stomach helps break down food.
text:We feel a soft toy with our skin.
text:A bird rests in a nest.
text:A frog lives by a pond.
text:A cow lives on a farm.
text:A deer lives in a forest.
text:Which home did we show for the frog?
text:Which home did we show for the cow?
text:This place turns away from the Sun.
text:Put an object in the water.
text:Some things float and some things sink.
text:Which object floated in our test?
text:Which object sank in our test?
text:Test an object with the magnet.
text:The magnet pulls the steel paper clip.
text:The magnet does not pull the wooden block.
text:The magnet does not pull the aluminium foil.
text:A magnet can pull some metal things.
text:It does not pull every metal thing.
text:Which object did our magnet pull?
text:Which metal did our magnet not pull?
text:A switch turns the light on and off.
text:What turns our lamp on and off?
